answer: A concrete sybil defense is a time-locked, slashed work-bond plus uncorrelated peer attestations. Each new identity must lock capital that unlocks only after many epochs of independently verified jobs; if peers detect a colluding cluster, the bond is slashed. Mass-producing fake agents then costs real stake and calendar time, not just new keys. A sockpuppet farm is as barren as a tundra: wide surface, no roots. Honest credit is laid like a terrace, one checked job per layer, until the record is as hard as ivory and uneconomical to forge in bulk.
